key_decisions: ONE FILE, ONE WRITER - shipped and proven. Do not reintroduce a second writer on app.log; stat-then-rotate is a race across processes and it destroyed a full session of history.
Retention is file COUNT, not file size: 256KB per file so an agent can read one whole, 20 archives for history.
Rotate-on-app-start was offered and DECLINED - quick restarts would churn tiny files and evict real history.
1.3.0 ALL THE WAY, NO BUMP - overwrite until right (user, 2026-07-31).
The 1.3.0 log entry covers the SINK bug (which shipped in 1.2.0) and the retention change. The rotation race never shipped, so it deliberately gets no entry.
MPI-418 was closed on the user's explicit approval after all four of its plan verification items passed.
constraints: NOTHING IS PUBLISHED. Latest live release is v1.2.0. master is at f73628b9; 20f1e743 and later are pushed.
Ask in PLAIN TEXT, never AskUserQuestion (the overlay hides the analysis above it).
The user gets confused by card-ID-heavy narration. Report OUTCOMES in plain language; keep card IDs in the files.

Build dispatch: gh workflow run cubric-vision-portable.yml --repo MadPonyInteractive/mpi-ci --ref main -f source_repo=MadPonyInteractive/Cubric-Vision -f ref=<FULL 40-CHAR SHA> -f version=1.3.0. ~6 min. A SHORT sha fails at checkout in ~40s. gh run download REFUSES to overwrite - move the old set aside first, and it lands in per-platform subfolders that need flattening.
CI gates builds on docs/releases/.approved-1.3.0.json. ANY releaseNotes.js edit stales it, including a peer's. Re-approve with `node scripts/release-notes-approval.mjs approve --yes`.
Piping a checker to `tail` swallows its exit code - validate_board.py 'passed' that way and had actually FAILED. Redirect to a file and read $? directly.
board.json has MIXED line endings; edit it with exact-string replacement, never a whole-file JSON rewrite. task.json is 2-space LF, handoffs 1-space LF. Verify every file parses after writing.
Shared tree with concurrent agents - commit by explicit pathspec, never git add -A.

Kill agent-spawned processes at the end: CubricVision.exe, the ComfyUI python, and any tail.exe a Monitor left behind (TaskStop does not kill the tail child, and the orphan locks the folder on Windows).
